messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need a decision on burst "windowing" for Dedicated GA. Two asks: some customers want daily replenishment, others weekly. Proposal A = daily small top-ups, Proposal B = weekly larger allowance. Thoughts on implementation complexity, billing UX, and SLA language?
ken: From runtime side: daily vs weekly is mostly a config flag. Complexity spikes if we support both semantics concurrently per-tenant (different refill intervals + carryover rules).
ken: Also need to decide carryover behavior: allow unused burst to carry to next period? that adds state and billing edge cases.
devon: Implementation notes: if we allow per-tenant intervals we need a periodic job + quota ledger sharding. Weekly windows mean fewer writes but larger reconciliation during rollovers. Daily means more frequent small reconciles.
devon: Autoscale interaction: if we do daily windows, autoscale burst gating should consider remaining window budget to avoid preempting latency-sensitive tenants near end-of-window. That adds a policy hook.
sarah: Sales input — two pilots (AcmePay, Findr) explicitly asked for daily replenishment because they have daytime peak patterns; finance prefers weekly for predictability. AcmePay offered to pay an add-on for daily.
alek: CS flag — billing visibility must be crystal clear. If unused burst carries over, customers will dispute why carryover didn’t apply. We need console calc and a CSV export for audit.
julie: Launch criteria suggestion: 1) telemetry: per-tenant daily/weekly consumption graphs, 2) billing: SKU + line-item for burst usage, 3) console: set refill cadence and carryover toggle, 4) rollout gated by two beta customers.
maria: Ops question — do we need SLA differences for daily vs weekly? e.g., guaranteed burst availability vs best-effort?
ken: SLA should stay at capacity/backfill level for reserved commit. Burst should be best-effort with clear latency targets for preempt behavior. If we promise daily guaranteed burst buckets, that's effectively committed capacity -> pricing changes.
sarah: Agreed. We can't call daily replenishment a "guarantee" without changing contract language. Sales can offer it as a paid add-on with clear doc language: "daily replenishment add-on (best-effort burst availability)".
devon: Tech debt note — if we add a carryover window, we must also add reconciliation for chargebacks and an alert when ledger mismatches occur. Plan ~2 sprint work + tests.
julie: Proposed rollout plan: build weekly default + admin toggle for daily in console (hidden feature flag), ship telemetry and billing first, then enable toggle for beta tenants.
alek: For disputes, add an export endpoint: POST /v1/admin/tenant/{id}/burst-ledger/export -> CSV that shows period, refill_amount, used_amount, carried_amount.
maria: Decision time: default to weekly refill for GA, implement per-tenant daily as paid add-on behind feature flag for pilots. Action items: ken + devon estimate impl effort (due Wed), julie draft launch checklist and docs (due Thu), sarah to confirm AcmePay willing to be pilot (pinged), alek define CSV fields and dispute flow. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy-bot posted a message: "staging deploy for quota-ledger v2 succeeded (build 202)" :white_check_mark:
maria: ok thanks all — I'll schedule a 30min alignment on Friday to review estimates and finalize roadmap.
